title: Putin holds Ukraine peace talks with Witkoff; American Hubbard freed
detail: Vladimir Putin held talks on a Ukraine settlement with US envoy Steve Witkoff, and Russia freed American Hubbard, per SCMP. Single-outlet report; details of the talks not yet confirmed by primary sources.

title: Kremlin says it is ready to resume three-way talks with US and Ukraine in mid-November
detail: The Kremlin said it is ready to resume trilateral talks with the United States and Ukraine in mid-November, according to France 24 and BBC reports.

media.caption: Kremlin ready to resume three-way talks
